250-779-1479-5413-8338.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5413-8338.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size.
250-779-1479-5413-8338.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability
Resolve the Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard Dakmor Salvage and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

1981-5147-5870.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
1981-5147-5870.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing any other creature you control, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and get {E}.
Repeat.

512-2872-7308.easyPrerequisites:
Mona Lisa and Clever Conjurer do not have summoning sickness.
Mona Lisa has power 2 or greater.
512-2872-7308.description:
Activate Mona Lisa by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Clever Conjurer and Mona Lisa, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Clever Conjurer ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-2872-7308.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Mona Lisa's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2506-3249-4474--52.easyPrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
The creature castable for one mana has the creature type chosen with Molten Echoes.
728-2506-3249-4474--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Molten Echoes triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

483-728-1981-2415.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, untapping it and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-2665-3680.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2665-3680.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Stunt Double and Progenitor Mimic each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Stunt Double trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Progenitor Mimic trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2665-3680.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

4091-7221-7791.notablePrerequisites: There's an Elf card in your graveyard.
4091-7221-7791.description:
Activate Lys Alana Dignitary by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Lys Alana Dignitary.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Lys Alana Dignitary.
Repeat.

2103-2187-5144.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Possessed Skaab and exiling Ephemerate.
When Possessed Skaab enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Possessed Skaab.
When Possessed Skaab enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-6835-6972.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Arcbound Overseer.
When Arcbound Overseer dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Overseer's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Overseer from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1651-1863-2638-6751-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-1863-2638-6751-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-1863-2638-6751-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker triggers twice due to Starfield Vocalist, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

2350-3532-4997-5078.notablePrerequisites: You control another Knight and/or Merfolk.
2350-3532-4997-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Knight and/or Merfolk you control.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2511-3234-3293-5412.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
2511-3234-3293-5412.description:
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat
2511-3234-3293-5412.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

3305-4681-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing Body Launderer to connive.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Body Launderer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

3490-4659-6796.description:
Cast Animation Module by paying {1}.
When Animation Module enters, Oreplate Pangolin triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on Oreplate Pangolin.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Oreplate Pangolin triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Oreplate Pangolin trigger, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on Oreplate Pangolin.
Repeat from step 3.

856-1808-4321-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Eloise's first ability triggers, creating a Clue and Food token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Eloise's second ability triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2825-5888.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {6}.
2825-5888.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping it, adding at least {6}.
Activate Elite Arcanist by paying {6} and tapping it, copying Flying Crane Technique and casting the copy without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Flying Crane Technique, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

1527-3129-4911.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls an indestructible creature, or you have a way to give an opponent's creature indestructible.
You control a number of artifacts greater than two times the indestructible creature's toughness.
1527-3129-4911.description:
Give an opponent's creature indestructible, if needed.
Activate Ghirapur Aether Grid by tapping two artifacts you control, dealing 1 damage to an indestructible creature an opponent controls.
If the creature has less than 0 toughness, Magmatic Galleon's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Repeat from step 2.

4518-5115-5283-5296.notablePrerequisites:
Workhorse has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Gemstone Array has at least one charge counter on it.
4518-5115-5283-5296.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {1}{W}.
Inexorable Tide triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Workhorse and a charge counter on Gemstone Array.
When Kor Skyfisher enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {W}.
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2-2060-2397-2744-5043.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
Alela triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
When the Faerie enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it and Cathars' Crusade trigger twice.
Resolve the Ancestral Statue triggers, returning it and the Faerie from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability four times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4}.
Repeat.

2292-3783-4300.notablePrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
2292-3783-4300.description:
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning a land you control to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Illusion token.
When the Illusion dies, Minn's second ability triggers, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

215-2499-4022.description:
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Hidden Herbalists to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Hidden Herbalists by paying {1}{G}.
When Hidden Herbalists enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

1182-1329-1379-4853.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1182-1329-1379-4853.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Stonecoil Serpent from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Stonecoil Serpent by paying {0}.
Stonecoil Serpent enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Emry.
Repeat.

193-1543-2984-4772.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional planeswalker.
193-1543-2984-4772.description:
Activate any other planeswalker you control by putting zero loyalty counters on it, putting a loyalty counter on Aminatou.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Ugin.
Ugin enters the battlefield with fourteen loyalty counters due to Doubling Season.
Activate Ugin by removing twelve loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2034-2299-2726-4871.notablePrerequisites:
"Skeleton" or "Warrior" chosen with Reflections of Littjara.
An opponent has lost life this turn.
2034-2299-2726-4871.description:
Cast Gutterbones by paying {B}.
Reflections of Littjara triggers, creating a token copy of Gutterbones.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gutterbones and the Gutterbones token, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
The Gutterboness die, triggering Pitiless Plunderer twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Gutterbones by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

643-1909-3421.notablePrerequisites: Willow Priestess does not have summoning sickness.
643-1909-3421.description:
Activate Willow Priestess' first ability by tapping it, putting Wirewood Symbiote from your hand onto the battlefield.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it to your hand from the battlefield, untapping Willow Priestess.
Repeat.

2440-5189.notablePrerequisites:
Ghave has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You control at least two Saprolings.
2440-5189.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Ghave, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
The Saproling enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Saproling, putting a +1/+1 counter on Ghave.
Repeat.

776-1329-2709-4474.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Orcish Mechanics do not have summoning sickness.
776-1329-2709-4474.description:
Tap Orcish Mechanics, sacrificing Paradise Mantle to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Paradise Mantle.
Cast Paradise Mantle.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

168-736-4753-4768.description:
Cast Copy Enchantment by paying {2}{U}.
Copy Enchantment enters the battlefield, triggering Altar of the Brood and itself.
Resolve the Altar of Brood trigger, causing each opponent to mill a card.
Resolve the Copy Enchantment's trigger, becoming a copy of Oblivion Ring and exiling Oblivion Ring.
Cast Clever Impersonator by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Clever Impersonator enters the battlefield, triggering Altar of the Brood and itself.
Resolve the Altar of Brood trigger, causing each opponent to mill a card.
Resolve the Clever Impersonator's trigger, becoming a copy of Copy Enchantment and exiling Copy Enchantment.
Copy Enchantment leaves the battlefield, returning Oblivion Ring from exile to the battlefield.
Altar of the Brood and Oblivion Ring triggers.
Resolve the Altar of Brood trigger, causing each opponent to mill a card.
Resolve the Oblivion Ring's trigger, exiling Clever Impersonator.
Clever Impersonator leaves the battlefield, returning Copy enchantment from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2876-3490.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other creature.
2034-2876-3490.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
Elenda triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.
